findings.obs_text: The surface regard carries over twenty codes in three uses. Of looking and heeding: H8159 in Gen 4:5, Exo 5:9 and Psa 119:117, H5027, H7200G, H6437G, H7789, H0995 in Psa 28:5, H7919A, H6485I, H3045, H8104J, and H5375Q in 2Ki 3:14 (to lift the face). Of counting as something: H2803H, H5234A, H5414I, H6188 in Lev 19:23, G3049, G2233, and G6063 with G1097 in 2Cor 5:16. Of a link of respect: H9006 in Judg 15:3, H1700 in Ecc 3:18, G4012 in Act 28:22, G3313 in Col 2:16. H0408, H3808, H0853 and H3820A are small words in the units.
findings.grounds: they do not regard the works of the Lord

findings.obs_text: The surface regarded carries four codes, all of counting as something: H2803H in Gen 31:15, Psa 44:22, Lam 4:2 and Hos 8:12, H2803J in Isa 29:16 and Isa 29:17, G1380 in Luk 22:24, G3049 in Rom 2:26 and Rom 8:36.
findings.grounds: Shall the potter be regarded as the clay
